The Saffarid page dates no Kerman or Makran conquest to 875 ('forced to recognize Ya'qub as governor of Sistan, Fars and Kerman', undated; Makran, Kerman, Fars, Khorasan conquered by his death in 879), so the fix is a Saffarid-side gain, handed off. The 699 cells added (Ahal, Mary, Razavi and North Khorasan) are Cliopatria's 875 shape over the Khorasan lost in 873; left.
